declare
 err_flag varchar2(1) ;
 err_msg varchar2(70) ;
 selection varchar2(1) ;
 al_button number ; 
begin
 :s_site_id := :s_site_id ;
 :s_from_date := :s_from_date ;
 :s_to_date := :s_to_date ;
 :s_donation_type_group := :s_donation_type_group ;
 :control_block.proc_code := :control_block.proc_code ;
 validate(block_scope) ;
 if not form_success then
 go_item(:global.failed_item) ;
 raise form_trigger_failure ;
 end if ;
 /*-- Check if site has been already opened --*/
 begin
 select 'x' into selection
 from fixed_site_slots
 where site_id = :s_site_id
 and chapter_id = :global.chapter_id
 and sch_date between :s_from_date and :s_to_date
 and donation_type_group = 
 decode(:control_block.s_donation_type_group,null,donation_type_group,:control_block.s_donation_type_group)
 and proc_code = decode(:control_block.proc_code,null,proc_code,:control_block.proc_code)
 and rownum = 1;
 set_alert_property('USER_ALERT',alert_message_text,'Please Read Carefully............
Slot Definition already exists for specified date range. Do you want to continue with new definition?');
 al_button := show_alert('USER_ALERT') ;
 if al_button = ALERT_BUTTON2 then
 raise form_trigger_failure ;
 else
 go_block('gen_data');
 end if ;
 exception
 when no_data_found then
 IF :FIXED_SITE_HOURS.week_day is NULL THEN
 set_alert_property('USER_ALERT',alert_message_text,'Please Read Carefully..............
No Slot Definition exists for specified date range. Do you want to continue with new definition?');
 al_button := show_alert('USER_ALERT') ;
 if al_button = ALERT_BUTTON2 then
 raise form_trigger_failure ;
 else
 go_block('gen_data');
 end if ;
 ELSE
 set_alert_property('DEFINITION_ALERT',alert_message_text,'Please Read Carefully.............
No Slot Definition exists for specified date range. Do you want to continue with New Definition or Current Definition?');
 al_button := show_alert('DEFINITION_ALERT') ;
 if al_button = ALERT_BUTTON3 then
 raise form_trigger_failure ;
 elsif al_button = ALERT_BUTTON2 then
 don_mcal_common.open_site(:s_site_id,
 :s_from_date,
 :s_to_date,
 :global.chapter_id,
 :s_donation_type_group,
 :control_block.proc_code,
 err_flag,
 err_msg) ;
 check_package_failure ;
 if err_flag = 'Y' then
 message(err_msg) ;
 raise form_trigger_failure ;
 else
 show_error('14003') ;
 go_block('fixed_site_slots');
 execute_query;
 end if ;
 else
 go_block('gen_data');
 end if ; 
 END IF;
 when others then 
 handle_error ;
 check_package_failure ;
 end ;
end ;

ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
PROCEDURE time_format_function (input_str in varchar2,output_str out varchar2) IS
 string_length number ;
 formatted_str varchar2(5) ;
BEGIN
/*-- This procedure formats time in HH24:MI format ---*/ 

string_length := NVL(length(input_str), 0) ;

if string_length > 5 then
 show_error('11110') ;
 check_package_failure ;
elsif string_length = 5 then
 if substr(input_str,3,1) = ':' then

 if to_number(substr(input_str,1,2)) > 23 or to_number(substr(input_str,4,2)) > 59 then
 show_error('11110') ;
 check_package_failure ;
 else
 output_str := input_str ;
 end if ;
 else
 show_error('11110') ;
 check_package_failure ;
 end if ;
elsif string_length = 4 then
 output_str := substr(input_str,1,2) ||':'||substr(input_str,3,2) ;
 if to_number(substr(output_str,1,2)) > 23 or to_number(substr(output_str,4,2)) > 59 then
 show_error('11110') ;
 check_package_failure ;
 end if ;

else
 show_error('11110') ;
 check_package_failure ;
end if ;
exception
 when value_error then 
 show_error('11110') ;
 check_package_failure ;
 when others then
 handle_error ;
 check_package_failure ;

END;

ProgramUnit.Name: NEW_SLOT
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
PROCEDURE new_slot IS
startdate date := :control_block.s_from_date;
enddate date := :control_block.s_to_date;
fromdate date := startdate;

s_start date := to_date(to_char(sysdate,'MMDDRR')||' '||:gen_data.day_start_time,'MMDDRR HH24:MI') ;
s_end date := to_date(to_char(sysdate,'MMDDRR')||' '||:gen_data.day_end_time,'MMDDRR HH24:MI') ;
slotstart date ;
v_time_of_day date;
v_insert_timeofday date;
v_gmt_time date;
BEGIN

 LOOP
 slotstart := s_start;
 LOOP
 BEGIN
 SELECT 'x' 
 INTO :GLOBAL.x
 FROM fixed_site_slots
 WHERE site_id = :control_block.s_site_id
 AND sch_date = fromdate
 AND donation_type_group = :control_block.s_donation_type_group
 AND proc_code = :control_block.proc_code
 AND chapter_id = :GLOBAL.chapter_id
 AND time_of_day = to_date(to_char(fromdate,'MM-DD-YYYY')||' '||to_char(slotstart,'HH24:MI'),'MM-DD-YYYY HH24:MI');
 IF :gen_data.conflict = 'A' THEN
 UPDATE fixed_site_slots
 SET max_slots = max_slots + :gen_data.s_capacity
 WHERE site_id = :control_block.s_site_id
 AND sch_date = fromdate
 AND donation_type_group = :control_block.s_donation_type_group
 AND proc_code = :control_block.proc_code
 AND chapter_id = :GLOBAL.chapter_id
 AND time_of_day = to_date(to_char(fromdate,'MM-DD-YYYY')||' '||to_char(slotstart,'HH24:MI'),'MM-DD-YYYY HH24:MI');
 ELSIF :gen_data.conflict = 'R' THEN
 UPDATE fixed_site_slots
 SET max_slots = :gen_data.s_capacity, 
 time_of_day = to_date(to_char(fromdate,'MM-DD-YYYY')||' '||to_char(slotstart,'HH24:MI'),'MM-DD-YYYY HH24:MI')
 WHERE site_id = :control_block.s_site_id
 AND sch_date = fromdate
 AND donation_type_group = :control_block.s_donation_type_group
 AND proc_code = :control_block.proc_code
 AND chapter_id = :GLOBAL.chapter_id
 AND time_of_day = to_date(to_char(fromdate,'MM-DD-YYYY')||' '||to_char(slotstart,'HH24:MI'),'MM-DD-YYYY HH24:MI');
 END IF; 
 
 EXCEPTION
 when no_data_found then
 v_time_of_day :=to_date(to_char(fromdate,'MM-DD-YYYY')||' '||to_char(slotstart,'HH24:MI'),'MM-DD-YYYY HH24:MI');
 
 /* -- Commented by Kishore on 08/17/2011. SCR 18384
 -- if IS_TIMEZONE_ENABLED then --MS (IM# 5057). Commented this line because this check is already being done in INITIALISE_WINDOWS trigger.
 if :global.time_zone_enabled ='Y' then
 Lifetrack_timezone_convert.get_gmt_time(:global.chapter_id,v_time_of_day,v_gmt_time);
 v_insert_timeofday :=v_gmt_time;
 --:fixed_site_hours.s_slot_time := to_char(:fixed_site_hours.slot_time,'HH24:MI') ;
 else
 v_insert_timeofday :=to_date(to_char(fromdate,'MM-DD-YYYY')||' '||to_char(slotstart,'HH24:MI'),'MM-DD-YYYY HH24:MI');
 
 end if;
 -- End If;
 -- End of commented section */
 
 insert into fixed_site_slots
 (site_id,
 sch_date,
 donation_type_group,
 proc_code,
 chapter_id,
 time_of_day,
 max_slots,
 booked_slots,
 program_id)
 values
 (:control_block.s_site_id,
 fromdate,
 :control_block.s_donation_type_group,
 :control_block.proc_code,
 :GLOBAL.chapter_id,
 to_date(to_char(fromdate,'MM-DD-YYYY')||' '||to_char(slotstart,'HH24:MI'),'MM-DD-YYYY HH24:MI'),
 --v_insert_timeofday, -- Commented by Kishore on 08/17/2011. SCR 18384
 :gen_data.s_capacity,
 0,
 'ADHOC') ;
 END; 
 slotstart := slotstart + (:gen_data.s_interval/(60*24)) ;

 if slotstart > s_end then
 exit ;
 end if ; 
 END LOOP;
 fromdate := fromdate + 1 ;
 if fromdate > enddate then
 exit ;
 end if ; 
 END LOOP;
 :system.message_level := 10;
 COMMIT;
 :system.message_level := 0;

 show_error('14003') ;
 go_block('fixed_site_slots');
 execute_query;
END;

ProgramUnit.Name: WHERE_FOR_SITE_HOURS
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
PROCEDURE where_for_site_hours IS
where_day_in varchar2(500);
where_day_day varchar2(500);
startdate date := :control_block.s_from_date ;
local_date varchar2(22):=to_char(get_local_date,'MM/DD/YYYY HH:MI:SS AM');
BEGIN
 -- Added single quotes before and after "local_date" variable. Added by Kishore on 08/10/2011. SCR 18384
 where_day_in := ' site_id=:control_block.s_site_id ' ||
 'and chapter_id=:global.chapter_id ' ||
 'and donation_type_group=:control_block.s_donation_type_group ' ||
 'and proc_code=:control_block.proc_code ' ||
 'and to_date('''||local_date||''',''MM/DD/YYYY HH:MI:SS AM'') between ' ||
 'eff_date and nvl(term_date,to_date('''||local_date||''',''MM/DD/YYYY HH:MI:SS AM'')+1)';
 --and sysdate between eff_date and nvl(term_date,sysdate+1)';
 IF :control_block.s_to_date - :control_block.s_from_date < 7 THEN
 LOOP
 IF where_day_day is NULL THEN
 where_day_day := ''''||to_char(startdate,'DY')||'''' ;
 ELSE
 where_day_day := where_day_day||', '''||to_char(startdate,'DY')||'''' ;
 END IF;
 startdate := startdate + 1;
 IF startdate > :control_block.s_to_date THEN
 exit;
 END IF;
 END LOOP; 
 where_day_in := where_day_in || ' AND week_day in ( ' ||where_day_day|| ' )' ;
 END IF;

 SET_BLOCK_PROPERTY( 'FIXED_SITE_HOURS', DEFAULT_WHERE, where_day_in);
END;
